svg.title: Harness map: in-product-agents layer
svg.desc: In-product-agents harness. dididecks-ai on the left, Instadeck on the right, artifacts grouped by category. Skills and the Chromium render are shared; eight pairs are similar, including the Markdown document chain. Four lines are missing on our side (a prompt pin, measured repair, a frozen corpus, acceptance runners) and one on hers (variants kept side by side per slot). Memory is different by design, and our planned embedded chat has no counterpart.
